content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-6|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-digital-products-what-actually-how-14|Tron USDT]], Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-17|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-17. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This architecture serves as a foundation for creators who want to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms. The significance lies in its ability to provide sovereignty over transactions, allowing creators to retain more earnings by minimizing fees. For instance, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, platforms like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%, which can lead to substantial savings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture leverages a combination of free tools and services to create a seamless experience for selling digital products. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can automate product delivery. This infrastructure ensures that creators own their sales process without depending on external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where payment platforms are inaccessible or overly restrictive. It empowers them to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more while maintaining full control over their products and transactions. By using this infrastructure, creators can avoid the pitfalls of high fees and limited payment options, ensuring they capture more value from their sales.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%, maximizing your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system consists of key elements: a hosting service (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers), a database (Supabase or Google Sheets), file storage (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments). Each component plays a crucial role in ensuring that transactions are smooth, secure, and automated, allowing creators to focus on their craft rather than technical challenges.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages. Then, set up your backend using Google Apps Script to handle orders. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. This straightforward approach will have you selling digital products in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Complete control over your sales process means no platform dependencies.

If you're looking to sell your Notion templates for crypto while avoiding high fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to help you build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments. This eliminates the need for conventional payment platforms.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This bypasses the need for traditional platforms with high fees.

NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This cost-effectiveness allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.

Yes, by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products. This ensures that customers receive their files immediately after payment confirmation.
